Actors Gaurav Khanna and Akanksha Chamola meet on Lock Upp 2 post divorce news

Actor Gaurav Khanna visited the reality show 'Lock Upp Season 2' where his wife, actress Akanksha Chamola, had previously revealed their divorce. During the visit, Khanna reportedly said to Chamola, "Band baja diya tune" (You've created a ruckus). Actress Hina Khan commented on the divorce revelation, calling it "very strange." Another report mentions Hina Khan and Rubina Dilaik discussing controversial TV issues, including the couple, and facing online trolling for it.
